beta.rationale: TEAM INPUT REQUIRED. No automated estimate per PRD B4; attach a regression or bottom-up beta.

capex_pct.rationale: FY2026 near the H1 2026 capex intensity, then easing. How long intensity stays elevated is the central question for this company; see the capex break-even and adverse scenario.

dna_pct.rationale: Rises as recent capex is depreciated (servers over six years per the FY2023 10-K). A PP&E roll-forward schedule would tie this to the capex path mechanically; that is the next model step.

equity_risk_premium.rationale: TEAM INPUT REQUIRED. Placeholder inside a commonly used range; no source attached. Replace with a cited figure (e.g. a published implied ERP) before relying on the value.

growth.rationale: FY2026 anchored below the H1 2026 year-over-year rate in the evidence table, then fading toward the terminal rate. The fade is a judgment, not a forecast from the filings.

operating_cash.rationale: All cash and marketable securities treated as excess for now; the team should decide a reserve.
operating_cash.units: USD of cash treated as operationally necessary (not excess)

operating_margin.rationale: Near the TTM margin in the evidence table. Depreciation is rising fast as the capex wave is placed in service, which is why margins are not extended upward in the base case.

tax_rate.rationale: FY2021-FY2025 effective tax rates in the dossier; 21% is the US federal statutory ceiling.
tax_rate.units: operating cash tax rate on EBIT

terminal_growth.rationale: Below the 10-year Treasury yield used as the risk-free rate.

terminal_margin.rationale: Equal to the FY2030 margin so there is no jump into the terminal value.
terminal_margin.units: operating margin in the terminal year

terminal_roic.rationale: Sets terminal reinvestment = growth / ROIC. Well below Alphabet's recent returns because the incremental AI capital may earn less; still assumes a durable advantage over the cost of capital.
terminal_roic.units: return on new invested capital in perpetuity

commercial_paper.quote: We had no commercial paper outstanding as of December 31, 2025 and June 30, 2026

adverse.rationale: Joint stress (PRD B5): growth normalizes faster while capex intensity stays higher for longer, and the new capital earns less. The pieces move together; they are not independent shocks.

favorable.rationale: Growth holds up, the capex wave normalizes quickly, and margins expand as revenue from the new capacity arrives. Assumes the investment earns high returns.

flat_ebitda.rationale: Base case, except EBITDA margin (operating margin + depreciation) is held at its FY2026 level of 39.5%, so operating margin falls as depreciation from the capex wave rises. Tests whether the base case quietly assumes margin expansion (it raises implied EBITDA margin from 39.5% to 44.5%).
